sloka: सूर्येणोदयता काले नक्षत्राणीव नाशिताः ।अहो सुबलवद्रक्षो वधोपायेषु युज्यते ।। ७.२४.१८ ॥
transliteration: sūryeṇodayatā kāle nakṣatrāṇīva nāśitāḥ ।aho subalavadrakṣo vadhopāyeṣu yujyate ।। 7.24.18 ॥

translations.english: Just as stars are destroyed by the rising sun, so too are our husbands, and alas, the very strong demon Ravana is engaged in means of killing.
